name: sound-scape-paus-rain
title: Paus rain
description: Each visible raindrop on Paus's glass becomes an audible tick, seeded like the drawing itself. Voice-limited and pooled (never more than a handful of oscillators at once, however hard it is raining), panned by where each drop sits and pitched a little higher for a smaller one. Only runs with the sound switch on, and stops when the scene leaves the viewport or the tab is hidden. attachPausRain(sceneEl) wires it to a live <sg-scene name="paus">.
